content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Supermarkets and shopping centres should be allowed to open on any Sundays and holidays. This may be a change for the employees that cannot to be implemented easily. However, especially for working customers this would mean greater flexibility and fewer nerve-racking peak times during the week. Considering the growing digitization of society, the traditional model of the weekend will soon be obsolete. Many European countries, for instance the Netherlands, Sweden and Great Britain, have already understood this and successfully adjusted the opening hours for retailers.
What is the relation between "This may be a change for the employees that cannot to be implemented easily." and "Supermarkets and shopping centres should be allowed to open on any Sundays and holidays." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
